an3.124:1.1: 125 yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti manasikātuṃpi me esā bhikkhave disā na phāsu hoti pageva gantuṃ
an3.124:1.3: addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu
an3.124:1.10: yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti manasikātuṃpi me esā bhikkhave disā na phāsu hoti pageva gantuṃ
an3.124:1.12: addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu ime tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu.
an3.124:2.10: yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti gantuṃpi me esā bhikkhave disā phāsu hoti pageva manasikātuṃ niṭṭhaṃ ettha gacchāmi addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu katame tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu kāmavitakkaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu katame tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu nekkhammavitakkaṃ abyāpādavitakkaṃ avihiṃsāvitakkaṃ ime tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū
an3.124:2.11: samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti gantuṃpi me esā bhikkhave disā phāsu hoti pageva manasikātuṃ niṭṭhaṃ ettha gacchāmi
an3.124:2.12: addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu ime tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsūti.
